segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I’ve got you down for 42 users at the Easton and Mesa locations, with a target go-live of May 6. Is that still right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. It may become 45 if we add the quality supervisors, but for budget approval I need the quote to show 42 seats and then the per-seat add-on price.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that’s straightforward. For 42 seats on the standard plan, annual subscription is $31,080. Additional seats would be $740 each per year, prorated if you add them mid-term.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And onboarding, you had mentioned a services package. Is that required or optional?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: For your setup, I’d recommend the basic onboarding package. It’s $4,200, includes two admin sessions, one end-user training, and help configuring the three inspection forms you sent over.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Finance will ask about payment terms. We usually do net 45 from invoice date, and we need the invoice split by location if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Net 45 is fine for this order size. And yes, we can split the invoice: 28 seats to Easton and 14 to Mesa, with the services line allocated 50-50 unless you want a different split.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, 50-50 is fine. Contract term would be twelve months starting May 1, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. May 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027. The app access can open May 1, and the first admin training would be May 2 or May 3 depending on your team’s availability.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let’s hold May 2 at 10 a.m. Central. I’ll need the order form today if possible so I can get it into our approval packet by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I can send it over this afternoon. It’ll show 42 seats, $31,080 subscription, $4,200 onboarding, net 45, split billing for Easton and Mesa, and the May 1 start date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy our procurement inbox. If legal has small edits, I’ll consolidate them and get back to you.
